expected.raw_text: research or applied science experience in machine learning

parsed.degree_signal: A PhD or equivalent industry research experience in machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field.
parsed.notes:
Treated the explicit 'Relevant experience includes' statements as candidate qualifications, defaulting to required; track-specific asks are not universal requirements across both tracks.
Treated research-agenda bullets as descriptions of proposed work rather than additional candidate qualifications. The introductory request for depth in those areas makes this boundary potentially ambiguous.
Distillation is required because its explicit Track 1 relevant-experience mention overrides the preferred mention.
Mapped offline RL to reinforcement-learning rather than inventing a separate taxonomy ID; retained bandits as unmapped.
Did not equate online experiments with A/B testing, or language-model post-training generally with fine-tuning.
The framework examples form the only alternative group with at least two retained taxonomy skills; NeMo RL, verl and OpenRLHF are additional unmapped alternatives in that same ask.
Excluded commerce domain knowledge, academic fields in the degree requirement, communication skills, and technologies mentioned only in company descriptions or benefits.
